_help: The countdown on a skill icon, the same in the buff bar, the key window, the quick slots and the skill window. maskR/G/B/A = the grey mask that covers the icon from the bottom up (the less time is left, the more is covered), maskInset = how many pixels it stays inside the icon edge on every side. Under 60 s the seconds left are drawn in the middle (secondsPx = the text size, secondsDx/secondsDy = the shift from the exact middle of the icon, secondsR/G/B = the colour); from 60 s on the minutes left are drawn at the bottom left (minutesPx = the text size, minutesX/minutesBottom = the space to the icon's left and bottom edge, minutesR/G/B = the colour). The layer count of a layered buff (Elemental Drain at the top right, Elemental Adaptation at the bottom right): countPx = the text size, countRight = the space to the icon's right edge, countTop/countBottom = the space to its top or bottom edge, countR/G/B = the gold colour. shadow = the offset of the black outline of all the text.
